run_delete_incomplete_folders: run the script to delete folders missing log.txt or with wrong line count
run_cleanup_coco_output: run the cleanup script to remove incomplete COCO output folders from a directory
run_validate_log_files: run the script to validate each folder has a log.txt with exactly 11 lines
run_remove_incomplete_results: run the script to remove result folders that do not contain the required number of caption lines
run_check_output_completeness: run the script to check and delete output folders with incomplete log.txt files
